basic_info.description: Stunning Marina Renovation by Mark Davis Design and Thompson Suskin Construction. This custom renovation in a prime Marina location offers unmatched architectural details, structural excellence, and a vibrant setting. This turn-key residence is an incredible value for those seeking luxury and style in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. Open yet defined floor plans seamlessly connect living, dining, and kitchen areas. State-of-the-art wiring for sound and internet, a new foundation, and a large garage with extra storage enhance modern convenience.  This unit also benefits from two exclusive outdoor spaces - a patio and a yard.
